"You’re right to demand “pixel-faithful first, structure second.”
Why I can’t “just line it up” (and what fixes it)
An SVG I invent from description will always drift, because there’s no hard constraint tying each stroke to the reference pixels. The fix is a two-phase pipeline:

Pixel-faithful clone (P0)

Treat the reference as ground truth.

Align (translate/scale/rotate) until edges overlap.

Iterate on anchors + contour control points until similarity passes a threshold.

Structured SVG refact"
